shareText: Your car remembers for you: inspection, IUC and insurance in one calendar. Three taps:

tips.diesel: Diesel in town: now and then drive 20–30 minutes at a steady pace — the particulate filter will thank you.
tips.ev: Electric cars don't pay IUC. Also check the e-mobility support schemes.
tips.madeira: Madeira: salt and steep hills — check brakes and underbody once a year.
tips.acores: Azores: humidity and salt — watch for underbody corrosion.

ipo.d: Deadline: end of the month; you can go up to 3 months early. Bring the Certificado de Matrícula. Before going: wash the car and check the lights.

service.d: Oil, filters, brakes, tyres and lights. One garage visit gets you ready for next month's inspection.

iuc.t: IUC — pay by the end of the month
iuc.d: Portal das Finanças → IUC → issue payment document. Tip: direct debit means you never forget.

iucNew.d: From 2027 IUC is paid in April (amounts up to €100). Check amount and deadline on Portal das Finanças.

ins.d: Compare prices before renewing. No valid inspection, no insurance.

season.t: Get the car ready for winter
season.d: Tyres (1.6 mm minimum), battery, wipers and air conditioning.

renew.d: Generate the next years at seedwave.pt/carro

about.ipo: Periodic inspection: at 4 years, then every 2 years until 8, then every year — in the month of first registration.
about.iuc: IUC road tax: in 2026, by the end of the registration month; from 2027, in April.
about.ins: Insurance: a heads-up before renewal so you can compare prices.
about.svc: Service: the month before inspection — one garage visit for both.

honest: Rules checked in October 2026. When in doubt, Portal das Finanças and IMT have the final word.

lite.title: Tenho carro! Lite — 3 steps and you're sorted for a year
lite.metaDesc: Inspection overdue? Fine up to €1,250. Three steps, one evening: insurance, service + inspection, vest and triangle. No sign-up, no long reading.
lite.kicker: For people who never have time
lite.h1: Inspection overdue? That's a fine up to €1,250.
lite.sub: Nobody likes thinking about this. So there are only three steps here. Do them tonight — and forget about it until next year.

steps.one: Check your insurance is paid and active. Without it, nothing else counts.
steps.more: Open your insurer's app or the last e-mail and look for the policy end date. The paper green card in the glovebox proves nothing any more — the certificate is digital. If renewal is close, get 2 quotes elsewhere: 10 minutes, typical saving €50–150 a year.

steps.one: Book a garage for oil, lights and a pre-check. From the garage go straight to the inspection (IPO).
steps.more: Then book the inspection at an IPO centre near you (Google Maps → “inspeção automóvel”). Price in 2026: about €38. Bring the registration certificate. If you're overdue: don't drive more than needed — the fine is €250–1,250.
steps.msg: Olá, queria marcar mudança de óleo e filtros, verificação de luzes e um pré-check para a inspeção. Matrícula __-__-__. Que dia têm livre?
steps.copyBtn: Copy the message for the garage

steps.one: Open the boot. A reflective vest and a warning triangle must be there — the law requires both.
steps.more: Any petrol station or supermarket sells the kit (vest + triangle) for €8–15. Without them at a police stop the fine can reach €600. Keep the vest within the driver's reach (glovebox or door pocket), not at the bottom of the boot. A first-aid kit is not mandatory in cars in Portugal — but it's a good idea.
